answer: At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a whisper tag. The summit cap is applied at intake and falcon reveals the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 28 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
